lines.en: Listen, uh, you guys think I have a chance with Janine?
Well, honey, we have been through this before.
Yeah, don't do this to yourself.
She made it pretty clear it is not going to happen.
I guess I shouldn't get too excited about the fact that I just kissed her!
Oh, we kissed it up real nice.
So you kissed her, so what happened after that?
I came over here to tell you guys.
So she's just waiting over there for you?
I'm going to be really late for dance class.
But, uh, hey, can you just leave your lips?
How are we going to get out of that one?
I can't handle two nights in a row with her.
What's wrong with Monica and Chandler?
She's just, she's very loud for such a small person.
Uh, they're like my best friends.
Are you saying we can't hang out with them?
Because that'd be kind of a problem.
No, of course we can still hang out with them.
Just, you know, not two nights in a row.
If you want, I'll sell my friends and use the money to buy you presents.
You know, you're not so quiet yourself, missy.
Listen, the only thing that's more boring than watching modern dance is having to listen to you talk about it.
Oh, Chandler, I just lost myself in the movement.
You know, I know you're talking, but all I hear is blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.
All right, you and me, let's go right now.
I, I, I, I gotta talk to Jeanine.
You know, I really think you could take her.
You better hope I don't see you in the hallway.
All right, uh, look, we got a, a little bit of a problem here.
These, these people are my friends.
You can't treat them that way.
They said stuff to me, too, you know?
I know, I know, and I'm, and I'm going to talk to them about it, but look, they mean so much to me.
They, they're like my family, you know, and if you guys are going to be fighting all the time, then I, I just, I don't think we can be together.
It's just, it just can't work, okay?
Okay, okay, would, would it help if I went over and apologized?
Yeah, yeah, that, that'd be very helpful, yeah.
What did I tell you about the hall?
I was just coming over here to apologize for my behavior.
I'd really like it if we could be friends.
Well, I know that would make Joey happy, so I would like that, too.
Oh, I'm glad we worked things out.
Hey, so, uh, did she move out?
Well, I cannot believe you just broke up with her just like that.
Well, when it's not right, you know it.
Yeah, well, I'll be all right.
You know what cheer you up?
I'm giving this lecture on erosion theories tomorrow night.
